name: MemoryLake CLI
description: Cross-device long-term memory: recall and remember facts, get stored files back, manage workspaces.
description_zh: 跨设备长期记忆：召回和记住事实、找回存进 MemoryLake 的文件，管理工作区、项目和团队权限。
description_en: Cross-device long-term memory: recall and remember facts, get stored files back, manage workspaces.
examples_zh: 用 MemoryLake 记住：我偏好用 pnpm，周报每周五下午发
在 MemoryLake 里查一下我之前说过的项目截止日期
把我之前存进 MemoryLake 的季度报告下载下来
MemoryLake 里关于发布流程的记忆有没有互相矛盾的
看看这个 MemoryLake 项目谁有读写权限
examples_en: Use MemoryLake to remember: I prefer pnpm and send weekly reports on Friday afternoons
Look up the project deadline I mentioned before in MemoryLake
Download the quarterly report I stored in MemoryLake earlier
Check whether MemoryLake holds conflicting memories about the release process
Show who can read and write this MemoryLake project
